Frequently Asked Questions

1) What is Kots Rive and where is it located?

A premium, fully managed studio apartment community in Koramangala, Bengaluru.

2) What type of apartments are available?

Fully furnished studio apartments (1RK) with compact, functional layouts.

3) Who is Kots Rive ideal for?

Single professionals, remote workers, digital nomads, and students seeking a central location.

4) Are the studios furnished?

Yes—bed, wardrobe, work desk, kitchenette, and Wi-Fi-ready setup.

5) What amenities are included?

24/7 security, housekeeping, power backup, high-speed internet, smart TV, geyser, refrigerator, AC, study table & chair, microwave/induction, and maintenance.

6) Can I rent short-term or long-term?

Both options are supported (typically 6 months and up).

7) Is it close to tech parks or coworking spaces?

Yes—near major tech hubs and coworking spaces in Koramangala and HSR Layout.

8) How much does a studio cost?

Rents generally start at ₹23,800 per month, depending on size and décor.

9) What makes Kots Rive a top choice?

Prime location, excellent amenities, managed services, and walkable access to food, shopping, and healthcare.
